MORE: With reference to captioned subject, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and in furtherance of Rights Issue of the Company, in terms of the Letter of Offer dated October 08, 2026 and in accordance with the Basis of Allotment finalized in consultation with BSE Limited (Designated Stock Exchange), the Registrar to the Issue i.e., Purva Sharegistry India Pvt Ltd and the Board of Directors of the Rights Issue Committee of the Company has, at its meeting held on today, i.e., November 02, 2026 approved the allotment of 1,96,68,019 Rights Equity Shares of face value of ?10/- for cash at an issue price of ? 10/- per Rights Equity Share. Consequent to the said allotment, the paid-up equity share capital of the Company stands increased from ? 6,14,62,560/- (consisting of 61,46,256 Equity Shares of ? 10/- each) to ? 25,81,42,750/- (consisting of 2,58,14,275 Equity Shares of ?10/- each).
